title: Interpolating conformal algebra in $(3+1)$ dimensions between the instant form and the light-front form of relativistic dynamics
summary: We extend the interpolation of the Poincaré algebra between instant form dynamics (IFD) and light-front dynamics (LFD) to the conformal algebra in $(3+1)$ dimensions. Building upon our recent formulation of the interpolating conformal algebra in $(1+1)$ dimensions, we propose an interpolation method for the conformal group $SO(4,2)$. A central feature of this work is classifying the $15$ conformal generators into kinematic and dynamic categories as a function of the interpolation angle ($0 \leq δ\leq \fracπ{4}$).
